words.tip:
The wheel, a pinch and the − button stop at Fit, so a sheet never shrinks past readable by accident.
Shift+wheel goes further (Ctrl+Shift+wheel when the wheel scrolls the page).
Shift is also the 0° / 45° / 90° lock while you draw: a point clicked with it still held snaps.
